title: Christmas House Ornament SVG Bundle
author: WoodNova
description:
Description
Bring a cozy Christmas village feeling to your holiday decorating with this charming Christmas House Ornament SVG Bundle! This collection features five festive house-shaped designs, each with a snowy rooftop and a cute Christmas character or holiday scene inside.
The layered designs are perfect for creating Christmas tree ornaments, holiday home decor, tabletop displays, personalized gifts, winter decorations, craft fair products, and DIY laser-cut projects.
🎄 Design Features
5 unique Christmas house ornament designs
Santa Claus inside a snowy Christmas house
Cute penguin with Christmas tree
Festive reindeer with Christmas tree
Gingerbread cookie with candy cane
Snowman with Christmas tree and snowy details
Snow-covered roof and chimney accents
Christmas trees, stars and winter elements
Built-in hanging holes for easy ornament display
Layered 3D wood-style appearance
Festive red, green, blue, white and natural wood palette
Perfect for Christmas tree decorations
Suitable for wood, MDF and acrylic
Clean laser-cut design elements
📁 File Formats Included
SVG
AI
EPS
DXF
DWG
PDF
⚙️ Compatible With
Glowforge, xTool, LightBurn, OMTech, Thunder Laser, Aeon Laser, Cricut, Silhouette Designer Edition, and most cutting machines/software that support SVG or DXF files.
